AdminNewQuestion.questionTextEmojiHint: You can use emojis as visual clues (e.g. 🎸🌹 = Guns N' Roses).
AdminNewQuestion.optionsLegend: Options (select the radio next to the correct answer)
AdminNewQuestion.optionsHint: Exactly 4 options are required. Empty options are not allowed.
AdminNewQuestion.acceptableAnswersHint: One answer per line. The first will be shown as the "correct answer" on reveal. The others are used only for fuzzy matching (lowercase, no diacritics, Levenshtein ≤ 2).
AdminNewQuestion.lyricTextPlaceholder: Put a ___ in his ___, pull my ___, he's ___ dead
AdminNewQuestion.lyricTextHint: Use {placeholder} (three underscores) wherever you want a blank.
AdminNewQuestion.blanksTooMany: No more than {max} blanks per question. Remove a few.
AdminNewQuestion.answersHint: Scoring is case-insensitive (Queen = queen). No variants — exactly one word per blank.
AdminNewQuestion.imageFileHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 6 MB. The image is stored on Cloudflare R2.
AdminNewQuestion.copyrightWarning: Make sure you have the rights to use this image. Recommended sources: Wikipedia (Creative Commons), official artist press kits, or original photos.
AdminNewQuestion.imageAttributionPlaceholder: e.g. Photo by John Doe / CC BY-SA 4.0
AdminNewQuestion.audioFileHint: Recommended 5–30 sec. .mp3 files only, up to 6 MB. Audio is stored on Cloudflare R2 and played through a signed URL.
AdminNewQuestion.audioOverRecommended: This file exceeds the recommended 30 sec. During the quiz the clip will be capped to the answer time limit.
AdminNewQuestion.audioSilenceWarning: Clip is {fileDuration} sec but the answer time is {timeLimit} sec — the last {silenceSeconds} sec will be silence.
AdminNewQuestion.audioCutWarning: Clip is {fileDuration} sec but the answer time is {timeLimit} sec — playback will stop at {timeLimit} sec (cutting {cutSeconds} sec).
AdminNewQuestion.spotifyHint: Start from a Spotify search to autofill the text and metadata. You can edit anything afterwards.
AdminNewQuestion.wikipediaHint: Start from a Wikipedia search to pull a thumbnail + attribution automatically. You can swap it for your own file afterwards.
